facts.statement: The genus Selenosteus belongs to the family Selenosteidae.
Fossils of Selenosteus have been found dating from the Frasnian to the Famennian periods.
Selenosteus lived during the Famennian stage, between 365.2 and 358.86 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Famennian to Famennian (365.2 to 358.86 million years ago)

facts.statement: The species Selenosteus brevis is known from the Famennian Cleveland Shale in Ohio.
facts.quote: Selenosteus brevis is an extinct large selenosteid arthrodire placoderm known from the Famennian Cleveland Shale of Ohio.

facts.statement: Remains from the Frasnian Rhinestreet Shales of New York were attributed to Selenosteus in 1919, but this identification is considered doubtful.
facts.quote: Scrappy remains from the Frasnian Rhinestreet Shales of Erie County, New York, were attributed by Hussakof and Bryant to this genus in 1919, but, this identification is doubtful.

facts.statement: A second species, S. kepleri, was described in 1901, but insufficient differences exist to justify its status as a separate species.
facts.quote: A second species, S. kepleri, was described in 1901, but, not enough differences can be seen between its specimens, and those of the type species to warrant new species status.

facts.statement: Selenosteus brevis had a wide skull with very large eye sockets.
facts.quote: According to its generally scrappy fossils, S. brevis had a wide skull with tremendous orbits.

facts.statement: Like other selenosteids, Selenosteus brevis possessed weak jaw plates.
facts.quote: And as typical for selenosteids, S. brevis had weak gnathal plates.

facts.statement: The median dorsal plate of Selenosteus brevis was crescent-shaped and featured a keel.
facts.quote: The median dorsal plate is crescent-shaped, and has a keel.

facts.statement: The average skull length of Selenosteus brevis is about 16 centimetres.
facts.quote: The average length of the skull is about 16 centimetres from the tip of the rostrum to the posterior border of the nuchal plate.

rejected.statement: Selenosteus is classified as a placoderm.
rejected.reason: quote not found verbatim in the source
